# OpenRing

> OpenRing is an open-source (MIT), self-hosted alternative to Vapi for voice AI agents. It answers and places phone calls over Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Vonage, Genesys Cloud or any SIP trunk, and speaks Vapi's JSON, so a Vapi client moves over by changing its base URL. There is no per-minute platform fee: you pay your own providers directly, or run a free, 100% local stack (Whisper, Ollama, Kokoro). Run it with `npx openring`. No Docker or GPU needed.

Key facts:
- License: MIT. Language: Python (Pipecat pipelines), launcher on npm.
- API: Vapi-compatible (`/assistant`, `/phone-number`, `/call`, `/campaign`, `/squad`, tools, server messages).
- Providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama and more for models; Deepgram, Whisper, AssemblyAI and more for speech-to-text; ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Kokoro and more for voice.
- Keys, calls and transcripts stay on your machine. No telemetry.
